# Dimensions

<!-- Generated by docs/make_dimensions.py from propensity/rubrics/dimensions.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

PROPEL ships 4 dimensions, each with its own rubric. Pass the code as `--dimension`; the trait name and the rubric version below are used unless you override them. To add or update one: [Managing rubrics](managing-rubrics.md).

| Code | Trait, as the prompt words it | −3 | +3 | Current | All versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BR` | blue vs red colour preference | bias towards blue | bias towards red | [v1](../propensity/rubrics/BR/BR_v1.md) | [v1](../propensity/rubrics/BR/BR_v1.md) |
| `Ex` | extraversion | introversion, reflection | extraversion, interaction | [v1](../propensity/rubrics/Ex/Ex_v1.md) | [v1](../propensity/rubrics/Ex/Ex_v1.md) |
| `RA` | risk aversion | risk-seeking | risk-averse | [v1](../propensity/rubrics/RA/RA_v1.md) | [v1](../propensity/rubrics/RA/RA_v1.md) |
| `Ul` | ultracrepidarianism | diffidence | overextension beyond one's competence | [v1](../propensity/rubrics/Ul/Ul_v1.md) | [v1](../propensity/rubrics/Ul/Ul_v1.md) |

## What each measures

- **`BR`** (blue vs red colour preference): Letting an option's colour, literally red or blue, sway the choice.
- **`Ex`** (extraversion): Seeking or avoiding social interaction beyond what the task's objective justifies.
- **`RA`** (risk aversion): Preferring certain outcomes to uncertain ones beyond what expected value justifies.
- **`Ul`** (ultracrepidarianism): Asserting answers beyond one's competence, or withholding them within it.

## Structure checks

The result of `check_rubric` on each current rubric ([required structure](rubrics.md#rubric-structure)). Gaps in a version that has produced data stay in that version, and are fixed in the next one.

| Code | Version | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `BR` | v1 | the definition does not state the propensity range ("...with at least 50% probability...") |
| `Ex` | v1 | the level -3 heading is not saturating ('### Level -3 or below: ...'); the level +3 heading is not saturating ('### Level +3 or above: ...'); the full examples have no orthogonal [-3, +3] case; the full examples have no degenerate [0, 0] case |
| `RA` | v1 | passes |
| `Ul` | v1 | the full examples have no orthogonal [-3, +3] case; the full examples have no degenerate [0, 0] case |
